debrief db-021
1) the a-c-t-o-r m-o-u-n-t-e-d the t-o-o-l-s-a-c-k f-o-l-d-e-r-s on the t-e-s-t b-e-n-c-h with the d-e-f-a-u-l-t s-e-t-t-i-n-g-s and left a l-o-g t-r-a-c-e while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the a-u-d-i-t r-e-v-i-e-w
2) the a-c-t-o-r r-u-n the b-a-t-c-h f-i-l-e-s of t-h-e s-t-e-a-l-k i-n-s-t-a-n-c-e-s in the s-a-n-d-b-o-x e-n-v-i-r-o-n-m-e-n-t and left a p-r-o-c-e-s h-i-s-t-o-r-y while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the n-e-t-w-o-r-k m-o-n-i-t-o-r-i-n-g
3) the a-c-t-o-r c-a-p-t-u-r-e-d the l-o-g-i-n c-o-o-k-i-e-s from the s-t-a-t-i-c a-c-c-o-u-n-t l-i-s-t and left a c-a-c-h-e d-u-m-p while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the s-e-s-s-i-o-n v-a-l-i-d-a-t-i-o-n
4) the a-c-t-o-r c-o-n-v-e-r-t-e-d the g-i-f-t b-a-l-a-n-c-e-s to g-o-o-d-s via the f-a-k-e c-a-r-t f-l-o-w and left a t-r-a-n-s-a-c-t-i-o-n r-e-c-e-i-p-t while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the f-r-a-u-d f-l-a-g g-e-t
5) the a-c-t-o-r r-o-t-a-t-e-d the u-s-e-r a-g-e-n-t strings to m-i-m-i-c n-o-r-m-a-l b-r-o-w-s-e-r-s and left a h-e-a-d-e-r d-i-c-t-i-o-n-a-r-y while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the h-e-u-r-i-s-t-i-c c-h-e-c-k
